bio.text: Madeleine Dean represents Pennsylvania's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House, won in 2018, and serves on the Appropriations and Foreign Affairs committees.
She served as an Abington Township commissioner from 2011 and in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from a 2012 special election win.
Born and raised in Glenside, Dean graduated from La Salle University, earned a law degree from Widener University's Delaware Law School, and taught in La Salle's English Department from 2001 to 2011.
